profile.summary: TalkingPoints is a nonprofit education technology organization that builds family-school partnerships. Its platform lets teachers and families send two-way messages that are automatically translated into many languages, and it offers tools for family engagement and attendance.

sources.title: Translation Helps Oakland Unified Communicate in Over 50 Different Home Languages - TalkingPoints
